overview_description.description:
Moonrig is a Web3 and blockchain technology platform that provides AI-powered tools for cryptocurrency research, portfolio management, and investment decision-making. The platform helps investors, analysts, and institutions analyse digital assets and manage crypto portfolios using data-driven insights.

Founded in 2021 and headquartered in Dubai, United Arab Emirates, Moonrig operates as a decentralised Web3 intelligence platform designed to simplify complex crypto investment processes. The company combines artificial intelligence, analytics, and community research to help users evaluate blockchain projects and build diversified digital-asset portfolios.

about_short_description.short_description: Moonrig is a Web3 and blockchain technology platform.

product.name: MOONBASE
product.description: An AI-powered research hub providing decentralized, expert analyst and AI-generated research papers on Web3 projects to support data-driven investment decisions.

product.name: MOONBUIDL
product.description: An AI-driven portfolio architect that guides users through risk assessment and builds tailored Web3 investment portfolios based on risk appetite, budget, and investment horizon.

product.name: MOONHODL
product.description: A digital asset manager offering consolidated views of all crypto holdings with profitability tracking, trend analysis, and extensive data points from multiple exchanges and wallets.

product.name: MOONCROWD
product.description: An early-stage Web3 investment platform enabling investors to participate in private sales and acquire equity and tokens in emerging crypto projects.

product.name: MOONCONNECT
product.description: A portfolio management tool that integrates crypto and traditional assets, balancing investments against liabilities for a unified financial strategy.

product.name: MOONAIRDROP
product.description: A marketing tool for Web3 projects to distribute free crypto tokens to targeted audiences, automating the airdrop process for projects and participants.
